name: Peter D. Haroldson
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Maple Valley, Washington
side_practice_areas: Estate Planning & Probate, Family Law, Estate & Trust Litigation
about: Peter D. Haroldson is a founding partner at the Law Offices of Torres & Haroldson in Maple Valley, Washington. With over 20 years of experience, he provides creative legal solutions for domestic relations, including child custody and divorce, while also advocating for vulnerable individuals in guardianship and probate. Dedicated to minimizing conflict and preserving family resources, he prioritizes personalized estate planning and litigation.

In his probate and estate planning practice, Mr. Haroldson handles estate administration, trusts, guardianships and will contests. He also represents civilian and military parents in domestic relations, focusing on minimizing conflict to protect children’s well-being. As a qualified guardian ad litem, he assists families and residential care facilities with complex legal proceedings. His creative approach ensures resources are preserved while resolving sensitive family and estate matters.

Earning his bachelor’s degree in cell and molecular biology from the University of Washington, Mr. Haroldson went on to enroll at Tulane University Law School for his law degree. Upon earning his Juris Doctor in 2004, he gained admission to practice in Washington in the same year. He started off as a deputy prosecuting attorney at the King County Prosecuting Attorney's Office, gaining valuable insight into the proceedings of the prosecution and the judiciary as a whole.

In the legal fraternity, Mr. Haroldson stays active through his memberships in the Continuing Legal Education Committee, the Guardianship Committee of the Tacoma-Pierce County Bar Association and the Washington State Bar Association. His “Superb” rating on Avvo showcases his dedication to providing quality legal services and his amiable approach towards his clients.
